rules.title: Mass. Gen. Laws ch. 186, § 15B(1)(b) - Maximum Security Deposit
rules.requirement: Landlords are prohibited from requiring a security deposit exceeding one month's rent at or prior to the commencement of the tenancy.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential leases and tenancies, excluding vacation or recreational leases of 100 days or less.

rules.exemptions: Leases, rentals, occupancy, or tenancies of 100 days or less in duration for vacation or recreational purposes.
rules.quoted_span: (iii) a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3) and that the tenant is given the statement of condition as required by subsection (2)

rules.title: Mass. Gen. Laws ch. 186, § 15B(4) - Security Deposit Return Deadline
rules.requirement: Landlords must return the security deposit, or the balance thereof after lawful deductions, to the tenant within thirty days after the termination of occupancy.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential tenancies, excluding vacation or recreational leases of 100 days or less.

rules.exemptions: Leases, rentals, occupancy, or tenancies of 100 days or less in duration for vacation or recreational purposes.
rules.quoted_span: The lessor shall, within thirty days after the termination of occupancy under a tenancy-at-will or the end of the tenancy as specified in a valid written lease agreement, return to the tenant the security deposit or any balance thereof
